intro.title: We don't just build buildings — we build a lasting legacy.
intro.body: DGN Yapı combines three generations of construction experience with modern engineering to create prestigious living spaces in İzmir. Every project carries the same care: seismic safety, material quality, architectural value, and on-time delivery.

featured.title: Doğan Yaşam Evleri
featured.body: At the city's new prestige hub, with 1+1, 2+1, and 3+1 luxury apartment options. Three blocks, social spaces, and ground-floor shops bring all the needs of life together in one location.

safety.title: Seismic Safety
safety.body: Built to the latest regulations with high-strength structural systems and certified materials.

materials.title: Material Quality
materials.body: We use branded, certified, durable materials and never compromise on detail.

architecture.title: Architectural Value
architecture.body: Designs led by our own in-house team of architects and engineers, prioritizing quality of life in every detail.

delivery.title: On-Time Delivery
delivery.body: We honor our commitments — every project is delivered on schedule and per contract.

ctaBanner.title: Let's build the home you dream of, together.
ctaBanner.body: Visit our sales office and see the project in person. Call us to lock in special launch pricing for early reservations.

about.title: Three generations, one signature on every build.
about.lead: DGN Yapı is a family business behind some of İzmir's most prestigious living projects, blending three generations of construction tradition with modern engineering.

story.title: Born from a family's word, given to the craft.
story.p1: DGN Yapı brings together decades of construction experience under a single roof. With every project, we sign our name to buildings that belong as much to our family as they do to İzmir's future.
story.p2: For us, a building is more than concrete and steel. It is a home for a family, a character for a neighborhood, and a lasting legacy for a city. That's why we treat every detail as if we were the ones moving in.

values.title: We honor what we promise — and stand behind what we build.

trust.title: Trust
trust.body: A contract is a starting point, not a finish line. We deliver on time, to the standard we promised.

quality.title: Quality
quality.body: Branded, certified materials. An in-house team of architects and engineers. We never compromise on engineering.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Open communication at every stage. From the construction site to the delivery date, we keep you in the loop.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: We design for tomorrow's lifestyle, not today's checklist. Our buildings are made to last.

process.title: How a DGN Yapı project comes to life.

steps.title: 01 — Land & Concept
steps.body: We analyze the character, needs, and potential of every location. The right project on the right plot.

steps.title: 02 — Architecture & Engineering
steps.body: Our in-house team of architects and engineers produces designs that prioritize seismic safety and quality of life.

steps.title: 03 — Construction
steps.body: Branded materials, certified subcontractors, and a transparent site under regular inspection at every stage.

steps.title: 04 — Delivery & Beyond
steps.body: After handover we stay with you through technical support and warranty — the relationship doesn't end at the door.

doganYasam.tagline: A prestigious project at the heart of life
doganYasam.overview: Doğan Yaşam Evleri rises in the Esenlik area of Karabağlar with three blocks and social living spaces. 1+1, 2+1, and 3+1 apartment options, ground-floor shops, and a modern landscape design promise a life that breathes at the heart of the city.
doganYasam.longBody: Blending modern lines with İzmir's character, the project comes with open and covered social areas, a large green garden, indoor parking, and 24/7 security as standard. Each apartment is planned for natural light and architectural continuity.

camlik.tagline: Modern living in touch with nature
camlik.overview: The Central Çamlık project sits where nature meets the city, offering a concept built for the needs of modern life. Call our sales office for details.

gunaltay.tagline: A new beginning in the heart of the city
gunaltay.overview: The Günaltay project delivered a new chapter at the heart of the city — apartments integrated into the city's vibrant fabric. Call our sales office for details.
